expression_intent.statement: A grounded, tactile and welcoming Highveld home with a strong connection to landscape, generous shared space and a quiet place for reading or focused work.
protected_features: A shaded outdoor room remains a resident priority.
The principal circulation should be easy to understand.
avoided_motifs: Avoid imposing cultural or historical motifs that the resident has not selected.
Avoid ornamental water use as a source of essential thermal comfort.

light: Useful daylight with controllable glare and summer solar gain.
acoustics: A quiet library/work setting separated from noisy social and service activities.
material_tactility: Honest, repairable finishes; tactile stone, timber or local alternatives may be explored.
thermal_feel: Comfort should not depend on discretionary water use.
spatial_sequence: A sheltered threshold leading to a shared hall and a protected outdoor room.

entries.description: A synthetic exploration of robust, tactile masonry and timber expression with contemporary openings and a sheltered courtyard.
A resident-selected inspiration for visible ecological systems, productive planting and energy-aware expression; not a claim of measured sustainability.
Explicitly excluded in this synthetic brief.
An open slot for a future resident-authored direction.
entries.custom_definition: To be written only by the resident; no default cultural interpretation.
